rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=7, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=300, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-5 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = train_n 200 -> 300 (the ONLY untried lever on LPD's Mayo arc). Everything physics/capacity held at iter-4's budget-compliant best-SSIM point (lpd_iters=3, hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, lr=7e-4 cosine, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); epochs traded 10 -> 7 PURELY to hold the HARD 20-min wall (see budget math). WHY DATA IS NOT INERT: the LPD solver loads a FIXED train_n subset ONCE via build_dataset->load_val_split (solver L81), then torch.randperm reshuffles that SAME fixed tensor each epoch (solver L257). There is NO per-epoch RotatingSubsetDataset rotation in this solver path, so train_n=200 has only ever shown the net 200 distinct slices out of the 579-slice train pool (3 patients: ps-groups 154/98/327). At Mayo train_n the loader stratifies round-robin across the 3 ps-groups, so 200->300 adds ~100 genuinely-new distinct slices spanning all 3 train patients (group-2 caps at 98) => +50% effective training set, still patient-balanced. LIMITER REFRAME: the SSIM 0.843->0.864->0.885->0.898 arc was driven by epochs (under-training), then lr (iter-4), with hr pinned at the LD-FBP floor (0.000) the WHOLE way; epochs is now wall-capped and lr is spent, but the net has NEVER seen more than 200/579 slices. Data-coverage is the unexamined axis. BUDGET MATH vs 1200s/20-min wall: total job time scales with total gradient steps = epochs*train_n (batch=1) + a small fixed ~95s (cuda init + the fixed 214-slice val pass). iter-4 = 2000 steps (ep10*tn200) ran 1100.7s=18.35min => conservative 0.503 s/step. iter-5 = 2100 steps (ep7*tn300) -> model 1151s=19.18min, +49s margin under the 1200s wall (ep8*tn300=2400 steps=21.7min OVERshoots; ep7 is the budget-fit epoch count for tn300). lpd_hidden^/lpd_iters^ stay OFF (add per-sample projector fwd+adj cost, blow the wall). HYP: +50% distinct (still patient-balanced) training data lets the LPD generalise to the held-out val patient L277 better than 200 slices did, lifting SSIM (predict ~0.90-0.92) and, if the extra coverage adds real high-frequency structure the 200-slice net was missing, pushing RMSE down enough to clear the LD-FBP floor (hr>0) for the first time on LPD's Mayo arc. FALSIFIER: SSIM plateaus at/below 0.898 (iter-4) AND hr still 0.000 => more data is NOT the lever; LPD is at its budget-constrained ceiling on 2304-view Mayo (~0.90 SSIM, hr 0) -- a projector-in-loop unrolled net that sharpens structure (rising SSIM) but cannot beat FBP on PSNR/RMSE within the 20-min budget at this capacity. The epochs-down-to-7 confound is bounded: if SSIM DROPS below iter-2's 0.864 (ep10/tn200) the cut went too far and tn300 needs a deeper wall, not this budget.
